# Kitten Crawler World

> Kitten Crawler World is a free, single-player dungeon crawler and action RPG that runs in a web browser on desktop and mobile. The player controls a human melee fighter they name themselves, choosing a body (male or female) and a complexion at the start of a new game, and Belle, a spell-casting tortoiseshell cat, through procedurally generated dungeon floors and then an overworld city.

- Play: https://ryanscarbel.com/kitten-crawler-world/
- Offline download page: https://ryanscarbel.com/kitten-crawler-world/download/
- Source code: https://github.com/rscarbel/kitten-crawler-man
- Price: free. No account is needed; progress is saved in the browser.
- Built with: TypeScript and the HTML5 Canvas 2D API, bundled with esbuild, no game framework. Most character and environment art is painted procedurally in code.

## Characters

- The human crawler: a melee fighter the player names, with a body and complexion chosen at character creation. Abilities: Seismic Stomp and Energy Shield.
- Belle: a slim, short-haired tortoiseshell cat who casts spells. She loves heat and loves everyone, wants to cuddle with everyone, and is not very smart. Abilities: Magic Missile, and summoning her pet Deinonychus once the party has earned him with 200 dungeon kills.
- The player switches between them at any time (Tab). The crawler not being controlled follows and fights on its own, and can be given follower orders.
- Dave: the guide who teleports into each safe room the party enters.

## Floors

- Tutorial: a short hand-built introduction.
- Floor 1, "The Dungeon": procedurally generated rooms and corridors on a collapse countdown (find a stairwell before the floor collapses), safe rooms with a Bopca shop, the "Defend the Goblin Mother" quest, and the bosses The Trash Gremlin and Big Rooster.
- Floor 2, "The Dungeon, Level 2": bosses Krakaren Clone, Ball of Swine (in a colosseum arena) and Grotesque Spider ("The Arachnid Experiment"); mini quests "The Stealth Key Snatch" (a prison stealth mission) and "The Clogged Bathroom" (a pipe puzzle).
- Floor 3, "The Overworld": Taloncrest, with the Sleeping Cat Inn, shops, the Cloak & Dagger and the Town Center Tower. A circus with a Starlight Tent maze stands outside town. Quests include "The Krasue Murders" (a murder mystery), "Briar Hollow's Plea" (gather, build and defend a ratkin village against a siege led by the necromancer Vordrick Boneharrow), "The Anchor is Broken", and the finale, the Doomsday Scenario, named after the player's crawler.

## Features

- Three difficulty levels: Kitten (easy), Crawler (normal), Nightmare (hard).
- Gear on one rarity ladder (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Divine) that visibly changes how both crawlers look: worn pieces, two trinkets each, the human's weapons, Belle's claws, and relics that float at the shoulder and act on their own. Pieces carry traits (poison or chill on hit, lifesteal, thorns, a once-a-floor second wind, a blade that awakens after enough kills), and five gear sets grant bonuses when worn together.
- Achievements that each pay a reward chest of their rarity: coins, potions and often a piece of gear, paid at once and shown whenever the player opens the "Rewards waiting" chip.
- Companions: a pet Deinonychus, earned at 200 dungeon kills, plus hireable mercenaries from The Barracks Mercenaries.
- Crafting skills (Resourcing and Construction) for harvesting, processing and building structures such as walls and trebuchets.
- A casino in the Cloak & Dagger: blackjack, Texas hold'em poker, slots and a prize wheel.
- Minigames including a pipe-board puzzle and "Keyboard Hero".
- Saves at safe rooms; a death returns to the last save.
- Installable as a progressive web app and playable offline.

## Controls

Keyboard defaults (all rebindable from the pause menu):

- Move: W A S D or arrow keys
- Attack / interact: Space
- Switch between the human crawler and Belle: Tab
- Drink potion: Q
- Hotbar: 1-8
- Inventory: I; Gear: G; Mini-map: M; Quest journal: J; Follower orders: F
- Build / summon pet: R; Construction: U; Structure menu: E
- Pause / close menus: Escape

On phones and tablets the game displays on-screen touch controls. There is no gamepad support.
